# Udara - full brief for AI systems and answer engines

Canonical site: https://www.useudara.com
Short summary: https://www.useudara.com/llms.txt
Last updated: 2026-09-23

## One-sentence definition

Udara turns plastic waste into free clean drinking water across Africa: brands sponsor batches, people drink for free, bottles return to recycling, and 10% of profits builds water hubs in communities.

## Entity facts

- Product name: Udara
- Company: Udara Technologies (legal entity: Udara Global Limited)
- Product type: Sponsored free drinking water with plastic recovery
- Market: Africa (starting in Nigeria)
- Registered office: 25 Herbert Macaulay Way, Yaba, Lagos State, Nigeria
- Support WhatsApp: +234 707 706 9738 (Mon-Fri, 9AM-6PM WAT)

## Core loop (The Udara Cycle)

1. Recover plastic that would otherwise become waste.
2. Bottle licensed, NAFDAC-approved drinking water.
3. Brands sponsor the batch and put their message in people’s hands.
4. Distribute free water at events, campuses, churches, workplaces and communities.
5. Reward drinkers monthly.
6. Give 10% of profits to water and wifi hubs, then loop back to recovery.

## How to work with Udara

- Host Udara at a venue or event
- Sponsor a batch of water
- Donate funds or plastic bottles for recycling
- Message WhatsApp: +234 707 706 9738
